name: Debbie Lesko
summary: Debra Kay Lesko ( LESS-koh; née Lorenz; born November 14, 1958) is an American politician from the state of Arizona. Lesko, a member of the Republican Party, serves on the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors representing the 4th district. She previously represented Arizona's 8th congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives from 2018 to 2025.
